steps.en: Offender chooses eNETS or card and proceeds to pay
steps.id: Offender memilih eNETS atau kartu lalu lanjut bayar

steps.en: The system creates the transaction and saves its initial records
steps.id: Sistem membuat transaksi dan menyimpan catatan awalnya
steps.why_en: If saving the records fails, the error is only logged and the offender is still sent to pay.
steps.why_id: Bila penyimpanan catatan gagal, error hanya dicatat dan offender tetap diarahkan membayar.

steps.en: The system asks the payment gateway for the bank page address
steps.id: Sistem meminta alamat halaman bank ke payment gateway

steps.en: Pay Now takes the offender's browser to the bank website
steps.id: Tombol Pay Now membawa browser offender ke website bank
